result_text:
`all_files.zip` is now built from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer drops it or `git-history.zip`. It compiles (`mvn -q -o -pl reports compile`). I didn't run any tests or a real export, so the renamed-aspect case is untested.

The change is in `DataExporter.java` (`reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/`), in the zip-writing block. The five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` entries are gone. The code now takes the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects in that order. For each one it gets the file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call that writes the loose text files. It reads that file and adds it to the zip under the same name.

With the default config the five entries and their order are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, and the `git-history.zip` step now runs as well.
